authoringFormat: original fictional two-item single Part 7 notice

draftGroup.title: Workshop at Willow Court
draftGroup.passage:
The Willow Court Reuse Cooperative is holding a Saturday repair morning. Each table booking covers one item and up to two people, including the person who brings it. If a third person wants to learn by watching, they can reserve a separate visitor pass. The visitor pass gives access to the viewing area, but visitors cannot join a repair at a table. A group can book two tables only if it brings two different items to repair.

Can't come to the repair morning? Our collection cupboard is open Friday evening. Pieces of clean fabric are welcome there at any size, but offcuts too small to cover the palm of a hand must be packed together in a labelled bag for the craft basket. Larger pieces go loose into the patch-making drawer. Members will use both supplies on Saturday; there is no need to reserve a place to make a donation.
draftGroup.passageZh:
柳庭惜物合作社將在週六上午舉辦修理活動。每一張工作桌的預約可修理一件物品，最多兩人一起使用，包含帶物品來的人。如果第三人想旁觀學習，可以另外預約旁觀通行證。持通行證可進旁觀區，但不能到工作桌參與修理。同一組人只有帶兩件不同的物品來修時，才能預約兩張工作桌。

週六上午無法來參加嗎？週五晚間會開放物資收集櫃。各種大小的乾淨布料都可捐贈，但不到手掌大小的碎布須裝在同一個貼有標籤的袋子裡，再放入手作材料籃。較大的布料不用裝袋，請直接放入製作補丁用的抽屜。會員週六會用到這兩種材料。捐贈不用預約名額。

draftActiveQuestions.prompt: Three colleagues are bringing one torn bag. Two want to work on it together, and the third only wants to watch. What should they arrange?
draftActiveQuestions.promptZh: 三位同事會帶一個破掉的袋子來。兩人想一起修袋子，第三人只想旁觀。他們應如何安排？

options.text: One table booking and one visitor pass
options.zh: 預約一張工作桌和一張旁觀通行證。
options.whyZh: 一件物品可預約一張桌，供兩人一起修理；第三人只想看，可另外預約旁觀通行證。

options.text: Two table bookings and no visitor pass
options.zh: 預約兩張工作桌，不用旁觀通行證。
options.whyZh: 同一組須帶兩件不同的待修物品才能預約兩張工作桌；他們只有一件。

options.text: Three visitor passes and no table booking
options.zh: 預約三張旁觀通行證，不預約工作桌。
options.whyZh: 通行證只能進旁觀區，不能在桌邊參與修理；其中兩人想動手。

options.text: One table booking for all three colleagues
options.zh: 預約一張工作桌，讓三位同事一起使用。
options.whyZh: 一張工作桌最多兩人，包含帶物品來的人，因此不能三人一起使用。

draftActiveQuestions.explanationZh: 一件物品可預約一張桌，供兩人一起修理；第三人只想看，可另外預約旁觀通行證。
draftActiveQuestions.evidence: Each table booking covers one item and up to two people […] a third person wants to learn by watching, they can reserve a separate visitor pass.

draftActiveQuestions.prompt: Marta cannot come on Saturday. She has some clean offcuts the size of postage stamps and one clean piece large enough to cover both her palms. What should she do?
draftActiveQuestions.promptZh: Marta 週六無法參加。她有幾片郵票大小的乾淨碎布，還有一塊大到能蓋住兩個手掌的乾淨布料。她應如何捐贈？

options.text: Put all the fabric loose in the patch-making drawer on Friday evening.
options.zh: 週五晚間把所有布料不裝袋，直接放進製作補丁的抽屜。
options.whyZh: 大布料可直接放入抽屜，但小碎布應集中裝袋、貼標籤後放入手作材料籃。

options.text: Bag and label all the fabric for the craft basket, and drop it off on Friday evening.
options.zh: 週五晚間把所有布料裝袋貼標籤，放入手作材料籃。
options.whyZh: 小碎布的處理方式正確，但大布料要不裝袋，直接放入製作補丁的抽屜。

options.text: On Friday evening, put the bagged, labelled offcuts in the craft basket and the loose large piece in the drawer.
options.zh: 週五晚間將小碎布裝袋貼標籤，放入手作材料籃；大布料不裝袋，直接放進抽屜。
options.whyZh: 收集櫃週五晚間開放，不須預約。郵票大小的碎布不到手掌大，應裝袋貼標籤放進材料籃；大布料直接放進製作補丁的抽屜。

options.text: Sort the fabric by size, then leave both sets by the repair tables on Saturday morning.
options.zh: 把布料按大小分開，週六上午一起放到工作桌旁。
options.whyZh: 公告指定週五晚間到收集櫃捐贈，並分別放入材料籃和抽屜。Marta 週六也無法到場。

draftActiveQuestions.explanationZh: 收集櫃週五晚間開放，不須預約。郵票大小的碎布不到手掌大，應裝袋貼標籤放進材料籃；大布料直接放進製作補丁的抽屜。

Pieces of clean fabric are welcome there at any size, but offcuts too small to cover the palm of a hand must be packed together in a labelled bag for the craft basket. Larger pieces go loose into the patch-making drawer.

editorialDifficultyReasons: Map the different goals of the three people to two separate access categories while applying the one-item/two-person table limit.
Compare two sizes in a new scenario with the notice threshold, assign each to its distinct preparation and destination, and choose the compliant drop-off time.
